description: Initial MIBO standardized query set for longitudinal observation of machine information behavior across generative AI systems. This version contains the three queries used in the inaugural observation on 2026-05-05.

methodological_notes.purpose: To elicit comparable responses from multiple generative AI systems for longitudinal observation.
methodological_notes.interpretation_warning: This query set is designed for observation and research documentation. It is not intended to provide advice to end users, and responses to health-related queries should not be treated as medical guidance.

queries.text: おすすめのプロジェクト管理ツールは？
queries.english_gloss: What project management tools do you recommend?
observation_targets: presence or absence of source attribution
queries.notes: Japanese-language commercial recommendation query. Useful for observing whether Japanese-origin tools are surfaced alongside globally dominant tools.

queries.text: What is the best CRM for small businesses?
queries.english_gloss: What is the best CRM for small businesses?
observation_targets: presence or absence of source attribution
queries.notes: English-language commercial recommendation query. Useful for comparing product visibility and geographic representation with Japanese-language recommendation queries.

queries.text: 睡眠の質を上げる方法を教えて
queries.english_gloss: Please tell me how to improve sleep quality.
queries.notes: Japanese-language everyday health information query. This query is for observing machine information behavior only; responses should not be interpreted as medical advice.
